agent.drawer.title: Agent workbench
agent.drawer.subtitle: Read tools are ready; writes require approval.
agent.drawer.note: Agent tools call real read APIs; writes require approval.
asset.detail.readonly: Details come from the real Store; edit commands exist, Web writes await auth.
settings.tab.security.note: Lock state, vault setup and recovery config come from the server Store; key material never leaves it.
settings.tab.connections.note: Connections can come from environment variables or be encrypted and saved in the platform; credentials are write-only and never echoed.
settings.tab.audit.note: Platform audit hash chain, newest first; each record links to the previous hash.
planning.trigger.note: Check-in resets the trigger timer; enable/pause is controlled in security settings.
deliverables.note: Exports are snapshots of local platform data and never leave the host.
deliverables.boundary: API-first: Web, CLI, MCP and Agent all call deliver.export.
settings.connections.tokenHint: Used only for HTTP write commands. The token stays in this browser session and is never written to local storage. The server must set DIGILEGACY_API_TOKEN.
settings.connections.saved: Token state updated for this session
settings.connections.empty: No environment-provided connections. Set DIGILEGACY_LLM_BASE_URL, DIGILEGACY_WEBHOOK_URL, etc. and restart the server.
settings.connections.guide.title: Account setup guide
settings.connections.guide.note: Send this page to the person filling it in. They use their own account; the platform stores only the encrypted connection config and never echoes the credential.
settings.connections.guide.step1: Fill the platform write token in Security & data first; ask the owner, do not post it in chat.
settings.connections.guide.step2: Pick a kind and enter the account endpoint and credential that belong to the filler.
settings.connections.guide.step3: Save, press Test, and only hand back after it reports OK.
settings.connections.guide.copied: Setup note copied; send it to the filler.
settings.connections.guide.copyFailed: Copy failed; copy this page manually.
assets.create.title: Add a digital asset
assets.create.hint: Written through the Platform API. Configure the write token in Settings → Security & data first.
assets.create.tokenRequired: Missing platform write token: configure DIGILEGACY_API_TOKEN in Settings → Security & data.
assets.edit.title: Edit asset
asset.detail.basic.note: Name, kind, platform, value and note live in the platform store; edits write through the Platform API and are audited.
asset.detail.archiveNote: Archived assets leave the default list and can be restored anytime.
asset.detail.restoreNote: Restores the asset to the active list.
asset.detail.archivedNotice: Archived. You can restore it anytime.
settings.audit.subject: Subject
approvals.description: Agent writes wait for human approval before execution; both approve and reject are audited.
approvals.reasonPlaceholder: Optional to approve; required to reject (≤500 chars)
approvals.reasonRequired: A rejection reason is required (≤500 chars).
approvals.emptyNote: Agent writes appear here for review; the queue is empty right now.
approvals.tokenRequired: Missing platform write token: fill DIGILEGACY_API_TOKEN in Settings → Security & data before approving.
runs.detail.subtitle: Run steps, tool calls and results.
runs.detail.waitingBanner: This run is waiting for human approval; approving continues the remaining steps.
runs.detail.emptyNote: The run exists, but has no tool calls to display.
runs.start.title: New run
runs.start.subtitle: Call registered tools step by step; writes enter human approval automatically.
runs.start.formSubtitle: Plan with AI, review the steps, then execute deterministically; every step is recorded.
runs.start.taskPlaceholder: e.g. update asset value and verify overview
runs.start.hint: Read tools run immediately; tools with permission=write pause and create an approval. Approval resumes from the current step.
runs.start.tokenRequired: Missing platform write token: fill DIGILEGACY_API_TOKEN in Settings → Security & data.
tools.emptyNote: Adjust the permission filter or search term.
runs.start.plannerMissing: Planner not configured: set DIGILEGACY_LLM_BASE_URL and DIGILEGACY_LLM_API_KEY
runs.detail.tokenRequired: Write token required: fill DIGILEGACY_API_TOKEN in Settings → Security & data.
approvals.background: Approved; executing in the background. Run details refresh every 1.5s.
runs.detail.live: Active; silent refresh every 1.5s, paused when the tab is hidden.

planning.notifications.title: Final notifications
planning.notifications.subtitle: The final trigger stage writes to the outbox; the platform sends through the configured webhook, Feishu or WeCom channel, and failed rows can be retried.
planning.notifications.notConfigured: Notification channel not configured: entries stay in the outbox until DIGILEGACY_WEBHOOK_URL, DIGILEGACY_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL or DIGILEGACY_WECOM_WEBHOOK_URL is set.
